result.summary: Found 3 visible issues: a major layout problem where the bottom restaurant card is cut off, a minor typo in the search placeholder, and a minor truncation issue with a restaurant name.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza item with '-20%' badge) is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, making the content appear broken and hard to interact with.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin above the tab bar so the last card is fully visible and the scrollable area extends beyond it.

issues.description: The search placeholder contains a typo: 'Restarantes' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated, missing the final character(s).
issues.suggestion: Increase card width, allow text wrapping, or apply a proper ellipsis so truncation looks intentional.
